faqs.a:
Every house in the city numbered after April 21, 1975, shall be numbered by the owner
               thereof with plain, distinct metal or composition numerals, of a color contrasting
               with the background, not less than four inches in height, and of a design approved
               by the city manager. Such numbers shall be placed upon some portion of the house visible
               from the adjacent street.
(Code 1960, § 21-13; Code 1981, § 30-103)
